candidates.name: Diffuse large B-cell lymphoma
support_spans: Biopsy of the glans penis ulcer showed dermal infiltrate of atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+
PCR analysis revealed a clonal IgH gene rearrangement
candidates.why: The presence of atypical lymphocytes with specific immunophenotyping and clonal IgH gene rearrangement supports this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Mantle cell lymphoma
candidates.why: The expression of CD5 by the lymphocytes could suggest mantle cell lymphoma, although other features are more typical of diffuse large B-cell lymphoma.

candidates.name: Follicular lymphoma
contradict_spans: atypical lymphocytes, which were CD20+, CD79a+, and CD5+
candidates.why: While the clonal IgH gene rearrangement could suggest follicular lymphoma, the presence of CD5 and the atypical lymphocyte morphology is less typical for this diagnosis.
